Output of this app is fully compatible with the original StegCloak (web & CLI).\nData is processed only on your device — no internet, no server.

string-array.name: sample_covers
string-array.item: Hey! Did you watch the game last night? It was absolutely incredible, everyone was talking about it today.
Just finished reading that book you recommended. Really enjoyed every single chapter of it, thanks a lot!
Meeting rescheduled to Thursday afternoon, please update your calendars and let everyone know.
Loved the photos from your trip! The mountains looked amazing. We should plan a trip together soon.
Today\'s weather is perfect! Let\'s go for a walk in the park. I\'ll be ready in two hours.
The new cafe downtown has fantastic coffee — you should definitely try it sometime.
